title: Kodambakkam station nameboard — photo-informed Blender reconstruction
attribution: Station sign photo texture: Gowtham Sampath, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Cropped, perspective-rectified and projected onto an estimated Blender reconstruction; derivative model and textures CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Only the inset sign face, a narrow upright surface sample and yellow border sample were extracted
Sign face perspective corrected using four manually selected corners
Original Tamil, Hindi and English lettering retained directly from the source photograph
Photo textures projected onto original extruded concrete geometry; no photographic surroundings included
Hidden surfaces, depth, exact size, support curves and edge details estimated
coordinates: glTF Y-up, front faces +Z, origin at ground-level center between posts
accuracy: Unsurveyed; no verified sign location, real measurements, matched camera calibration or blind fidelity pass
